title: Computational screening proposed MOF linkers for carbon capture
summary: A diffusion model generated candidate metal-organic-framework linkers, a graph model estimated CO₂ capacity and molecular-dynamics simulations screened stability among 120,000 candidates. The result is computational candidate discovery; physical synthesis and measured capture were not reported.
